title: Interviews with Monster Girls
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where 'demis' (vampires, dullahans, succubi and snow women) live among humans, high school biology teacher Tetsuo Takahashi has always wanted to meet one. When four demi students arrive at his school, he gets to know them and helps them through the ups and downs of school life. Database tags note a student's crush on the teacher.
life_message: Curiosity, patience and respect for people who are different help everyone belong.
